notes.subject: mi bagarapim rot
notes.rationale: חטא em i 'lusim rot / bagarapim rot' — i no 'sin' long pasin bilong Nupela Testamen

notes.subject: למשא
notes.rationale: 'baren long bel bilong mi' (KJV/JPS) o 'baren long yu' (BSB) — Hibru עלי i klia 'long mi', tasol ol man i tambuim

notes.subject: חטאתי
notes.rationale: Raitim past o askim: KJV 'I have sinned', ASV/JPS 'If I have sinned' — Hibru perfect i save wankain tupela

notes.subject: Job i toktok wantaim Elohim
notes.rationale: Tok i go stret long God, yu lukautiman bilong ol man

translation: Mi bagarapim rot — wanem mi ken wokim long yu, yu lukautiman bilong ol man? Bilong wanem yu putim mi olsem target bilong yu, na mi kamap baren long bel bilong mi?
